title: Word Search Board Game - Solution
intuition: Given an m x n grid of characters board and a string word, return true if word exists in the grid.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
time_complexity: O(m * n * 4^L) where L is length of word
common_mistakes: Use DFS at each cell. Mark visited cells to avoid reusing them. Unmark them on backtracking return.
